description: Wrap-around of 16- and 32-bit integer arithmetic, truncating division and remainder, shifts into the sign bit.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: Two's complement arithmetic on 16- and 32-bit operands as avr-gcc generates it for volatile operands (computed by hand: 32767+1 = -32768, 200*200 = 40000 mod 65536 = -25536, -7/2 = -3, -7%3 = -1); signed results describe this toolchain, not the C++ standard
